name: CLINC150: Intent Classification and Out-of-Scope Detection Dataset
description: CLINC150 (also known as the CLINC OOS Evaluation dataset) is an intent classification benchmark comprising 23,700 conversational queries across 10 diverse domains and 150 in-scope intent categories, accompanied by a dedicated out-of-scope (OOS) query set. Designed to test real-world task-oriented dialog robustness, it benchmarks both standard intent prediction and out-of-domain rejection capabilities.
